page_key.description: ProgressPage this comment is anchored to

subject_type.description: What exactly the comment is about. Drives how the prompt generator frames the fix.

subject_ref.description: Identifier of the subject: metric name, component path, entity name, function name, column key

subject_label.description: Visible text or label of the thing being commented on, captured automatically

observed_value.description: The value on screen when the comment was made, e.g. the lead count that looked wrong

finding_type.description: Classification, carried through to any finding created from this comment

captured_context.description: JSON blob: route, query params, filters, role, theme, viewport, commit, data source. Captured automatically at comment time.

snapshot_id.description: PageSnapshot this comment is anchored to, when the comment was drawn on a screenshot

region.description: JSON {x, y, w, h} in natural image pixels, so the box can be redrawn on the snapshot later

crop_url.description: Uploaded PNG of just the selected region. Small, and enough to see what was meant without opening the full capture.

element_selector.description: Best-effort CSS path of the element under the selection, resolved at draw time

element_audit_id.description: data-audit-id of the element under the selection, when the component carries one

converted_finding_id.description: AuditFinding created from this comment, when converted

converted_change_request_id.description: ChangeRequest created from this comment, when converted

parent_thread_id.description: Set on replies. Root comments leave this empty.

author_role.description: Progress role of the author at comment time
